description: Stereo effects loop switched in and out by a gate, with a gain control and a choice of tails on the return

params.text: Picks what happens to the effects return when the loop is switched out: Hard cuts it dead, Soft leaves it running so reverb tails and delay repeats fade away
Sets the gain on the effects return, -30dB counter-clockwise through 0dB at noon to 12dB clockwise
Picks how the launch works: Latch toggles the loop on and off, Gate switches it in only while the trigger is high or the button is held
Switches the loop in and out by hand, toggling it in Latch mode and holding it in only while pressed in Gate mode

inputs.text: The right side of the signal going into the loop; with nothing patched here the left input feeds both sides
The left side of the signal coming back from the effect
The right side of the signal coming back from the effect
Switches the loop in and out, toggling it on each rising edge in Latch mode and holding it in while high in Gate mode
The left side of the signal going into the loop

outputs.text: The left side of the signal on its way to the effect, silent while the loop is switched out
The right side of the signal on its way to the effect, silent while the loop is switched out
The left side of the finished signal: the dry input when the loop is out, the effects return when it is in
The right side of the finished signal: the dry input when the loop is out, the effects return when it is in

notes: with the module bypassed each input is passed straight to the output on its own side
nothing is normalled from the sends to the returns, so with the loop switched in and the FROM FX inputs empty the outputs fall silent; patch an effect from TO FX round to FROM FX first.
menu: Soft clip at ±10V — saturates both outputs rather than letting them run past 10V; on by default
Slew time — a slider setting how long the switch takes to fade between dry and effect, from 5ms to 50ms, and 10ms by default

inputs.3: high above 1V · stepped · one channel only
